claw.name: Warband
claw.text: On Order — you may move 1 [Mob] to the Domain with the most cards. Brawl there.

claw.name: Raid
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — discard 1 card from your Domain.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — give 1 card from your Domain to the active player.

claw.name: Scavenge
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — remove 1 card from your discard from the game.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — the active player takes 1 card from your discard.

claw.name: Blood Offering
claw.text: On Order — discard 1 card from your Domain. Rite every Domain.

claw.name: Poach
claw.text: On Order (no other [Hunt] in play) — Feast your Domain. Draw 1 card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Worship of the Hunt
claw.text: On Rite — discard 5 Claw cards to the active player's discard.

claw.name: Worship of the Dusk
claw.text: On Rite — every player discards 1 card from their Domain. If Worship of the Dawn is in play, discard 2 instead.

claw.name: Worship of War
claw.text: On Rite — the active player Brawls in a Domain of their choice.

claw.name: Incite
claw.text: On Dawn — move up to 3 [Mob] cards from your Domain to other Domains. Discard Incite.

claw.name: Chiefdom
claw.text: On Dawn — move up to 2 [Mob] cards from your Domain or a culture ally's to any other Domain.

claw.name: Kinship
claw.text: On Harvest — Order the Tree zone.

claw.name: Racketeering
claw.text: On Order — choose a player. They offer you 1 card. Take it, or refuse and Brawl their Domain.

claw.name: Tyranny
claw.text: On Order — draw cards from the Claw deck equal to your [Discontent] count. Brawl your Domain.

claw.name: Marauders
claw.text: On Feast — discard Marauders. Draw 1 card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Share the Spoils
claw.text: On Feast — draw 1 card from the Claw deck.

claw.name: Martial Excellence
claw.text: On Order ([Trophy] in your Domain) — Order the Sword zone.

claw.name: Outriders
claw.text: On Order — draw 3 cards from the Claw deck. Discard 1 of your choice.

claw.name: Land Grab
claw.text: On Order ([Land] in the Season) — take all [Land] cards from the Season to your Domain. Discard Land Grab.

claw.name: Rite of Passage
claw.text: On Brawl — draw 1 card from the Tree deck.

claw.name: Culling
claw.text: On Dawn — the player with the most cards discards 1–2 cards of their choice. Discard Culling.

claw.name: Ivory
claw.text: On Order — discard Ivory. Order the Coin zone.

claw.name: Hunger
claw.text:
On Harvest — discard 1 Claw card to your discard.
On Feast — return 1 card from your discard to top of the Claw deck.

claw.name: Uprising
claw.text: On Dawn — Brawl your Domain. Discard Uprising.

claw.name: Ransack
claw.text: On Order — discard 1 card from your Domain. Draw 2 cards from the Claw deck. Take 1 from the Season.

claw.name: Spoils of War
claw.text:
On Dawn — place Spoils of War in another player's Domain.
On Brawl — moves to the active player. They draw cards from the Claw and Tree decks equal to their [Trophy] count.

claw.name: Veil Tear
claw.text: On Order — remove any number of cards from your discard from the game. Return that many [Spiritual] cards from any discard to their owner's Domain. Rite every Domain that many times. Discard Veil Tear.

claw.name: Blood Feud
claw.text: On Brawl — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck. Move up to 2 [Mob] to the active player. Discard Blood Feud, then Brawl the active player's Domain.

claw.name: Enforcers
claw.text:
On Brawl (*your turn*) — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.
On Brawl (*not your turn*) — you and the active player each draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.

sword.name: Royal Hunt
sword.text: On Order (no other [Hunt] in play) — Feast your Domain twice. Draw 1 card from the Claw deck.

sword.name: Gold Coat
sword.text: On Rumour, Brawl — discard a [Unit] anywhere. Gold Coat moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Iron Crown
sword.text: On Dawn — discard a [Unit] anywhere. Iron Crown moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Green Mantle
sword.text: On Harvest — discard a [Unit] anywhere. Green Mantle moves to that Domain.

sword.name: White Shield
sword.text: On Feast — discard a [Unit] anywhere. White Shield moves to that Domain.

sword.name: Holy Cross
sword.text: On Rite — discard a [Unit] anywhere. Holy Cross moves to that Domain.

tree.name: Kinship
tree.text: On Harvest — Order the Tree zone.

tree.name: Eldership
tree.text: On Brawl — if the active player shares your culture, you may cancel the Brawl. They draw 1 card from the Tree deck.

tree.name: Worship of the Dawn
tree.text: On Rite — return 1 card from your discard to your Domain. If Worship of the Dusk is in play, return 2 instead.

tree.name: Reaping
tree.text: On Dawn — Harvest every zone. Discard Reaping.

tree.name: Gathering
tree.text: On Dawn — choose Brawl, Rite, or Rumour. Fires in your Domain and all culture allies' Domains. Discard Gathering.

tree.name: Sacred Grove
tree.text: On Order — choose one: • Rite your Domain. • Look at the top 3 Tree cards. Take any [Spiritual] cards. Return the rest.

tree.name: Worship of the Hearth
tree.text: On Rite — Harvest every Domain that has Kinship.

tree.name: Forage
tree.text: On Order — discard top 2 Tree and top 2 Claw cards to your discard. Feast your Domain.

tree.name: Sowing
tree.text:
On Order (2+ [Nature] in your Domain) — Order the Wheat zone.
On Harvest — refill the Season, then put all [Nature] cards from the Season into your Domain.

tree.name: Compost
tree.text: On Order (Reaping card in your discard) — choose one: • Order the Wheat zone. • Remove the Reaping card from the game, then Harvest your Domain.

tree.name: Vigil
tree.text: On Harvest — for each player with Kinship, return 1 card from your discard to your Domain.

tree.name: Floods
tree.text:
On Brawl — if another Floods is in play, cancel the Brawl.
On Dawn — refill the Season. If another Floods is in play, every player discards 1 card from their Domain.

tree.name: Bog
tree.text: On Rumour — remove 1 card from the Season from the game.

tree.name: Bear's Den
tree.text: On Feast — draw 1 card from the Claw deck.

tree.name: Ravine
tree.text: On Brawl — the active player discards 1 card from their Domain.

tree.name: Meadow
tree.text: On Harvest — refill the Season to full.

tree.name: Regrowth
tree.text: On Dawn — all [Nature] cards in every player's discard return to their owner's Domain. Discard Regrowth.

tree.name: Hospitality
tree.text: On Order — choose a player with Kinship. You may Order 1 card in their Domain. They may Order 1 card in yours.

wheat.name: Animal Husbandry
wheat.text: On Order — choose one: • Order the Wheat zone. • Order the Coin zone. • Feast your Domain.

wheat.name: Tavern
wheat.text: On Feast — you may return 1 [Discontent] from your Domain to top of the Claw deck. You may return 1 Claw card from your discard to top of the Claw deck.

wheat.name: Militia
wheat.text:
On Rumour — discard 1 [Mob] from your Domain.
On Brawl — discard Militia to cancel the Brawl in your Domain.

wheat.name: Crooked Inn
wheat.text: On Rumour — return 1 [Mob] from your discard to your Domain.

wheat.name: Enclosure
wheat.text: On Order — take any 1 card from the Village. Put 1 card from your Domain back in its place.

wheat.name: Turnip Patch
wheat.text: On Order, Harvest — Order the Wheat zone.

wheat.name: Ritual Pyre
wheat.text: On Order — discard a card from your Domain. If you do, Harvest your Domain. Rite your Domain.

wheat.name: Folk Hero
wheat.text: On Dawn — move 1 [Mob], [Labour], or [Amenity] card between domains that have Wheat cards.

wheat.name: Wolf Pack
wheat.text:
On Harvest (*your turn*) — move Wolf Pack to another player's Domain.
On Harvest (*not your turn*) — discard 2 from Domain, draw 2 cards from the Claw deck.

wheat.name: Herb Garden
wheat.text: On Harvest — Order the Tree zone or Wheat zone.

wheat.name: Orchard
wheat.text: On Harvest — draw 1 card from the Tree deck. Feast your Domain.

wheat.name: Reeve
wheat.text: On Dawn — Order 1 Wheat card in your Domain.

wheat.name: Worship of the Bread
wheat.text: On Rite — rearrange the Village belt.

wheat.name: Ora et Labora
wheat.text:
On Harvest — Order the Candle zone.
On Rite — Order the Wheat zone.

wheat.name: Tax Collectors
wheat.text: On Order (3+ [Labour]) — Order the Coin zone. Rumour your Domain.

wheat.name: Tidings
wheat.text: On Rumour — choose one, then Discard Tidings. • *Panic* — draw 2 cards from the Claw deck. • *Fortify* — return 1 [Discontent] to top of the Claw deck.

wheat.name: Pilgrimage
wheat.text: On Order — give 1+ cards from your Domain to another player. They decide: if they accept, draw that many cards from the Candle deck. If they refuse, no reward. Discard Pilgrimage.

coin.name: Market
coin.text: On Order — offer a Ware to a player. If they accept, Order the Coin zone.

coin.name: Pawn Shop
coin.text:
On Order — Order the Coin zone.
On Rumour — swap 1 Domain card with 1 Wares card.

coin.name: Stockpile
coin.text: On Order — put 1 Domain card into Wares. Order the Coin zone.

coin.name: Smuggler
coin.text: On Brawl — you pick 1 from Wares, the active player takes it. Smuggler moves to the active player's Domain.

coin.name: Forgery
coin.text: On Order (Coin card in Domain) — put Forgery into Wares. Order the Coin zone.

coin.name: Usurer
coin.text:
On Order — put 1 Domain card into Wares.
On Rumour — Order the Coin zone.

coin.name: Highwaymen
coin.text: On Brawl — put 1 Domain card into Wares. active player Orders on the Coin zone.

coin.name: Sellsword
coin.text: On Brawl — discard Sellsword to the Wares to cancel the Brawl your Domain.

coin.name: Swindle
coin.text: On Order — give all Wares to a chosen opponent. Brawl their Domain. Discard Swindle.

coin.name: Prosperity
coin.text: On Dawn (Opportunities) — draw 1 card from the Coin deck.

coin.name: Embassy
coin.text: On Dawn (culture ally and Wares) — you and your ally each take 1 card from the Wares.

coin.name: Efficiency
coin.text: On Order — Order up to 4 other cards in your Domain. Discard Efficiency.

coin.name: Spice Market
coin.text: On Order — draw cards from the Coin deck equal to your count of unique tags in your Domain.

coin.name: Commodities
coin.text: On Rumour — draw 1 card from a chosen deck. Add it to the Wares.

coin.name: Provisions
coin.text: On Feast — draw 1 card from the Coin deck.

coin.name: Worship of Gold
coin.text: On Rite — the active player takes 1 card from the Wares.

candle.name: Worship of the Scripture
candle.text: On Rite — the active player peeks at Candle cards, scales with [Spiritual]. Keep 1, remove the rest from the game.

candle.name: Worship of the Relic
candle.text: On Rite — peek at cards from a chosen deck, scales with [Spiritual]. May replace the Revelation. Return rest to top.

candle.name: Worship of the Martyr
candle.text: On Rite — the active player may discard cards. All other players must discard equal to [Spiritual] scaling.

candle.name: Clergy
candle.text: On Order — Order the Candle zone. Peek at Candle cards, 1 per player with [Religion]. Keep 1, may set 1 as Revelation, remove the rest from the game.

candle.name: Zealot
candle.text:
On Brawl — cancel if you have [Religion]; else discard 1 Domain card.
On Rite — active player may move Zealot to another Domain.

candle.name: Alms
candle.text: On Feast — refill 1 Field. Return 1 [Discontent] to top of the Claw deck.

candle.name: Evangelism
candle.text: On Order — each player in turn order claims 1 Revelation. Refill between each.

candle.name: Purity
candle.text: On Order — you may remove the Revelation from the game and reveal the next. Rite your Domain.

candle.name: Penance
candle.text: On Dawn — discard 2 cards from your Domain. You may discard Penance.

candle.name: Ornament
candle.text: On Order — move the Revelation to the Wares. Reveal the next card.

candle.name: Protect the Meek
candle.text: On Brawl — Order the Sword zone.
